items.name: Soothing Tonic
items.description: A weak but stable draught made from restorative residue.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: A reliable restorative made from common valley herbs.

effects.description: Restores the body and steadies the nerves.

items.name: Echo Healing Draught
items.description: A healing draught with a softer second pulse worked into it.

effects.description: Restores more vitality in an echoed wave.

items.name: Field Poultice
items.description: A rough sun-and-meadow salve that closes up the scrapes a work crew earns in a day.

effects.description: Eases minor hurts and takes the sting out of tired hands.

items.name: Calmleaf Infusion
items.description: A quiet green infusion brewed for people who have forgotten how to sleep.

effects.description: Loosens a clenched jaw and lets a racing head settle.

items.name: Verdant Restorative
items.description: A deep-green tonic that coaxes vigor back into tired bodies and tired beds alike.

effects.description: Restores a solid measure of vitality and steadies growth.

items.name: Bloomrise Elixir
items.description: A refined restorative that wakes dormant roots and thin bodies in one long green pulse.

effects.description: Pours a lasting bloom of vitality into whatever drinks it.

items.name: Greenmend Salve
items.description: A cool, clean salve tuned for wilted planter beds and delicate specimens.

effects.description: Feeds tired roots and settles skittish growth.

items.name: Purified Draught
items.description: A clean, exacting restorative prized by buyers who pay for a flawless pour.

effects.description: Restores vitality with an unusually clean finish.

items.name: Wellspring Elixir
items.description: A masterwork-grade restorative, the sort of pour a town remembers.

effects.description: Floods the body with clean, lasting vitality.

items.name: Moonmoth Salve
items.description: A restorative that leaves a faint moth-light halo, easy on frightened patients at night.

effects.description: Restores vitality with a calming glow.

items.name: Kindling Tonic
items.description: A warm hearth-tonic that puts heat back into cold hands on an autumn morning.

effects.description: Restores warmth and a little vigor against the cold.

items.name: Nightglass Lantern
items.description: The desert's own lantern. Starlight settles the mixture until the glass keeps a cold, tireless flame.

effects.description: Holds a cold, near-inexhaustible light through a whole night route.
Eases the chill that comes with walking the dunes after dark.

items.name: Mirrorsalt Draught
items.description: Salt-pan flake cut with reedflower, clean enough that the town's water carriers drink it straight.

effects.description: Restores vitality and clears the grit of a long dry route.

items.name: Wardfrost Tonic
items.description: Cold ward frost carried in quietbloom. Brewed entirely from things the tower grew for itself.

effects.description: Restores deeply and leaves the drinker unusually settled.
